Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the coffee and the chat on Thursday. As promised, here's how we'd approach the spring push.

The idea: "First Light." A six-week campaign built around your early-morning regulars — short videos shot at the Harbor Rd shop between 6 and 7am, a limited spring blend, and a loyalty card that only stamps before 9.

What's included:
  - 12 short-form videos for Instagram and TikTok
  - In-store posters and a sandwich board
  - Launch email to your 4,000 subscribers
  - A simple dashboard so you can see redemptions week by week

Timeline would be 3 weeks of prep starting in February, launching March 16.

Budget: we'd estimate $18–22k depending on how many locations take part. If this direction feels right, I'll put together a formal scope and quote.
